% Beamer source: the braced frame title, plus the leading-<overlayspec> variant
% that fell through every regex until it was found on a real course. Both are
% ordinary, legal Beamer; both need converting (see C-FRAMETITLE).
\documentclass{beamer}

\begin{document}
\begin{frame}[c]{Objectives}
Body text.
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}<1>[c]{Overlay spec ahead of the options bracket}
Body text.
\end{frame}
\end{document}
